verdict.rationale: Casium says it 'reviews your achievements, shows you honestly how strong your case is' and advertises 'No RFE or assessment fees,' which suggests a no-cost case-strength assessment. Its blog also explains the EB-1A criteria. However, the evidence describes a team-led review and static guide content, not a self-serve structured qualifier on the site. missing for 10: evidence of a self-serve interactive O-1/EB-1 eligibility tool or quiz, explicit confirmation that the assessment is free for individual founders, details on how the assessment is structured, independent or hands-on corroboration.
